c301b7728f1ce7b9.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث مؤسسة آفاق الاحترافية التجارية عن محاسب للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية إعداد وتنظيم المستندات المالية، ومتابعة تحصيل الإيرادات، وتسجيل العمليات المحاسبية، بالإضافة إلى تدقيق الحسابات البنكية وإعداد التسويات اللازمة. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى المحاسب مجموعة من المهام المحاسبية والمالية لضمان دقة السجلات والتقارير، وتشمل هذه المهام ما يلي: تدقيق المطالبات المالية والتأكد من استيفائها للشروط القانونية والمالية. إعداد وتنظيم وتوثيق مستندات الصرف ومتابعة تدقيقها وإجازتها من الجهات الرقابية المعتمدة. مراقبة النفقات الجارية والرأسمالية بناءً على الموقف المالي الشهري لبنود الموازنة. إعداد الموقف المالي والخلاصات الشهرية، بالإضافة إلى إعداد وتنظيم الحسابات الختامية السنوية. إعداد القيود المحاسبية وتسجيل العمليات المالية في السجلات، وتدقيق حسابات البنوك وإعداد التسويات اللازمة مع كشوف المطابقة الشهرية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات المحاسبة ومواكبة التطورات العلمية والتقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة في محاسبة النفقات والإيرادات وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة لشغل هذه الوظيفة، يجب أن تتوفر في المرشح المؤهلات والخبرات التالية: خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال المحاسبة. القدرة على إعداد وتحليل التقارير المالية. معرفة جيدة بمبادئ المحاسبة والمعايير المالية. مهارات ممتازة في تنظيم وتوثيق المستندات المالية. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الفرصة الوظيفية في مدينة الرياض، وهي وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق مؤسسة آفاق الاحترافية التجارية. التقديم للوظيفة ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لمناقشة تفاصيل الراتب والمراحل التالية من عملية التوظيف.

c33d8bb4af4e9c1d.description: The Internal Auditor - Operations performs independent, risk-based operational audits across the organization in alignment with the Internal Audit Charter, methodology, and IIA Standards (IPPF). The role assesses governance, risk management, internal controls, and policy/regulatory compliance across end-to-end operational activities (hubs, logistics, fleet, gateways, customer service, cash/COD, and technology systems). Responsibilities Audit Planning & Preparation: Research operational areas, map process flows/risks, participate in pre-audit meetings, draft risk-and-control matrices, and establish sampling strategies. Shipment & Process Assurance: Audit full end-to-end logistics processes (booking, sorting, linehaul, delivery, POD, returns) and evaluate custody, scan sequence, timestamps, and seal controls. Cost, Productivity & Asset Reviews: Assess operational efficiency drivers (manpower, route/vehicle utilization, fleet maintenance, facility costs) and evaluate vendor/outsourced courier compliance against contracts and SLAs. Cash, COD & Revenue Controls: Test courier debriefs, COD collection/reconciliation, billing accuracy, and system inputs to prevent revenue leakage, loss, or unsupported write-offs. Data Analytics & Systems Assurance: Use Excel, Power BI, or analytical software to test 100% data populations, detect anomalies/overrides, and verify core operational system integrity. Safety, Security & Compliance: Review facility/fleet security, CCTV, safety protocols, regulatory permits, and incident escalations. Testing & Documentation: Execute testing, maintain evidence-backed working papers, and expand sample sizes when control failures are detected. Reporting & Recommendations: Draft clear audit observations, establish root causes, assign risk ratings, and propose practical corrective action plans. Action Follow-Up: Verify and test management closure evidence before signing off on resolved findings. Key Role Boundaries & Escalation Independence: Must remain objective and disclose any conflicts of interest or past operational roles immediately. Immediate Escalation: Suspected fraud, theft, deliberate control bypass, major shipment/cash loss, or severe safety/regulatory breaches must be escalated immediately. Formal Investigations: The auditor must not conduct formal fraud/misconduct investigations unless explicitly assigned under the formal investigation procedure. Decision Rights Category Scope May Decide Day-to-day audit execution, sample selection, evidence requests, routine walkthrough scheduling, and initial working paper drafts. May Recommend Scope expansion, control improvements, finding risk ratings, procedure changes, and fraud referrals. Requires Approval Audit scope/objective changes, final audit reports/ratings, external disclosures, and formal finding closures. Must Not Decide Operational policies, process ownership, control design/operation, risk acceptance, vendor selection, or disciplinary actions. 5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Audit Delivery (20%): Complete ≥95% of assigned audit tasks and milestones by scheduled target dates. Working-Paper Quality (15%): Achieve ≥95% compliance with audit documentation standards. Finding Evidence (15%): 100% of reported observations backed by traceable, verified evidence. Reporting Timeliness (15%): Draft observations submitted within agreed engagement deadlines. Critical Escalation (10%): Escalate 100% of validated critical risks/fraud indicators within 1 working day. Follow-Up Verification (10%): Complete ≥95% of assigned management action verifications on schedule. Data Analytics Usage (10%): Apply analytics/data testing in ≥80% of audits with available data. Professional Development (5%): Complete minimum 40 hours of relevant training annually. Bachelor’s degree in Internal Auditing, Accounting, Finance, Supply Chain, Logistics, Business, or Engineering. Certifications: CIA (or in-progress), CFE, CRMA, CPA/ACCA, or ISO Lead Auditor preferred. Experience: Minimum 3+ years in internal audit, operational audit, risk, or compliance. Experience in logistics, transport, supply chain, or e-commerce is strongly preferred. Technical Skills: Strong proficiency in Excel; experience with Power BI, SQL, or audit management software is an advantage. Key Competencies: Professional scepticism, evidence-based judgment, root-cause analysis, concise report writing, and stakeholder communication.

c35c562eb9c2f2a3.description: About Johnson & Johnson and the Cardiovascular Team At Johnson & Johnson, the focus is on healthcare innovation to address complex diseases and deliver advanced solutions. The company operates with a commitment to its employees, fostering an inclusive work environment that respects diversity and recognizes individual merit. This role is within the Cardiovascular team, which develops solutions for heart recovery, electrophysiology, and stroke, aiming to advance standards of care for patients with conditions such as heart failure and atrial fibrillation (AFib). Role Overview: Bids and Tender Senior Specialist, EP MEA The Bids and Tender Senior Specialist, EP MEA, supports the comprehensive bids and tender management process for the Electrophysiology business across the Middle East and Africa (MEA) region. This full-time position, based in Makkah, Jeddah, or Riyadh, focuses on ensuring submissions are timely, compliant, accurate, and competitive to support business growth and mitigate risks. The role involves managing tender execution in close collaboration with various internal functions, including Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain, Finance, Legal, Compliance, and Regulatory teams. The specialist contributes to effective tender evaluation, submission, award management, and post-award activities, while also supporting the Bids and Tendering Leader in enhancing tools, governance, reporting, and process discipline within EP MEA. The position requires 2-5 years of experience, strong stakeholder engagement, adherence to compliance standards, commercial acumen, and a continuous improvement mindset. Key Responsibilities Coordinate and manage the full bids and tender lifecycle across EP MEA, including pre-tender, quotation, submission, award, and post-award stages. Manage tender sourcing, application, documentation, and submission processes to ensure timely, high-quality, compliant, and competitive EP bids. Review tender requirements, evaluation criteria, technical specifications, commercial terms, and submission checklists for completeness and accuracy. Analyze tender outcomes through win/loss reviews, pricing simulations, competitor insights, and debriefs to inform future EP bid strategy. Maintain bids and tender databases, trackers, and central platforms to ensure data quality, visibility, and reliable reporting across EP MEA. Review legal, commercial, technical, and operational aspects of tender documents and escalate risks for timely resolution. Ensure tender activities comply with customer requirements, corporate policies, SOPs, approval matrices, and SOX control requirements. Collaborate proactively with EP Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain, Finance, Regulatory, Legal, Compliance, and other functions to secure complete and value-added submissions. Act as a subject matter expert for EP bids and tender processes, tools, documentation standards, and compliance requirements. Prepare and share regular bids and tender performance metrics, dashboards, and reports with the Bids and Tendering Leader and relevant stakeholders. c37b01eab7227794.description: About Red Sea Global and Botanica Red Sea Global is seeking a Manager, Landscape Maintenance to join Botanica, a subsidiary dedicated to providing sustainable greenery across Red Sea Global's destinations. Botanica focuses on integrating new species with local flora and aims to cultivate 30 million plants by 2030, shaping the natural landscapes of The Red Sea & Amaala. This full-time role is based in Tabuk, specifically covering sites in Umluj and Tabuk. Role Purpose The Manager, Landscape Maintenance will oversee landscape maintenance operations across assigned sites. This involves ensuring high-quality landscape presentation, optimal plant health, efficient irrigation performance, operational efficiency, and compliance with HSE standards. The role also includes leading Supervisors and field teams, managing resources, monitoring performance, and coordinating with internal stakeholders and clients to ensure effective service delivery. Key Responsibilities Manage daily landscape maintenance operations across assigned sites. Develop weekly and monthly maintenance plans and ensure activities are completed according to schedules. Lead and supervise Landscape Maintenance Supervisors, technical teams, and field workforce. Oversee all softscape and horticultural activities, including pruning, mowing, planting, fertilization, weeding, mulching, and plant replacement. Monitor plant health and landscape quality, implementing corrective actions for pests, diseases, and other horticultural issues. Oversee irrigation performance and coordinate with irrigation teams to maintain schedules and improve water-use efficiency. Conduct regular site inspections to ensure areas meet quality and service standards. Manage manpower planning, workforce deployment, productivity, and utilization. Monitor landscape maintenance KPIs, work orders, service requests, and corrective actions. Manage requirements for plants, fertilizers, chemicals, tools, machinery, and other landscape materials. Coordinate purchase requisitions and material requirements with Procurement and support functions. Review and validate operational invoices and documentation related to landscape maintenance services. Monitor contractor and service-provider performance, ensuring compliance with scope, quality, and safety. Ensure effective utilization and maintenance of landscape machinery, tools, and equipment. Ensure full compliance with HSE requirements, environmental standards, and safe working practices. Coordinate with Nursery, Irrigation, HSE, Procurement, Finance, Logistics, Facilities, HR, and other operational teams. Maintain communication with clients and stakeholders, addressing operational concerns and service issues. Prepare and review daily, weekly, and monthly operational reports. Monitor operational costs and identify opportunities for cost optimization and productivity improvement. Support mobilization and operational readiness for new landscape maintenance areas. Identify operational risks, manpower gaps, and quality concerns, escalating critical matters to the Senior Manager. Coach and develop Supervisors and field teams to strengthen technical capability and team performance. Drive continuous improvement in landscape quality, sustainability, water efficiency, and service delivery. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of experience in landscape maintenance management. Demonstrated ability to manage day-to-day landscape operations and lead field teams. Experience with softscape and horticultural activities, plant health, and irrigation systems. Knowledge of HSE requirements and environmental standards. Interactions and Work Environment This role involves extensive coordination with various internal departments, including Admin, Legal, Finance, Projects, Procurement, Compensation, IT, Marketing, Audit, and HR. The position requires working in a dynamic environment focused on sustainable development within Red Sea Global's destinations in Umluj and Tabuk.

c3b518f032fc3118.description: About Tahreez Tahreez is a Saudi systems integrator and technology contractor specializing in advanced security, communication, AV, AIoT, healthcare digitalization, and data center solutions. c3b69805efb95749.description: About the Role DUBAI HOLDING is seeking a Guest Services Executive for Front Office to join Jumeirah Jabal Omar in Makkah. c3c4c5544b50c48a.description: About the Role Acwa is seeking an experienced Operation Manager to lead the Operations department of a plant in Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves managing all operational and laboratory-related activities to ensure the effective achievement of production targets, while maintaining operational efficiency, quality, cost, and HSE standards. Report regularly to the Plant General Manager / Country Manager on operational activities, challenges, and mitigations. Contribute to budget preparation and monitor financial performance, identifying and rectifying unsatisfactory performance. Lead the effective monthly and daily scheduling of plant shift operations to meet production targets. Manage all aspects of power generation and/or water production, focusing on efficiency, safety, and quality. Troubleshoot and resolve escalated operational issues to achieve production objectives with minimal liquidity damages. Review daily operations reports and submit periodic reports to management. Lead operational management meetings to ensure clarity on production standards and programs. Provide technical recommendations to improve equipment reliability and operational efficiency. Ensure regular safety protective device tests on critical equipment. Plan and facilitate preventative and corrective maintenance programs with the Maintenance department. Support the safe execution of planned outages and provide assistance during equipment shutdown and re-starting. Oversee the setting of production parameters and adjust conditions to ensure quality and efficiency. Monitor laboratory activities to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and quality standards. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in operations management within a plant environment. Demonstrated ability to lead and manage an operations department. c3eb230e13584cc4.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة تكوين للصناعات المعدنية عن فني كهربائي تمديدات كهربائية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل الوظيفة مسؤولية دراسة مخططات التمديدات الكهربائية، تقدير المواد، متابعة التنفيذ، وتشخيص الأعطال، مع الالتزام بمعايير السلامة المهنية. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة وتحليل مخططات التمديدات الكهربائية بمختلف أنواعها (منزلية، صناعية، تجارية) ومكوناتها. تقدير كميات المواد والأجهزة المطلوبة لتنفيذ أعمال التمديدات الكهربائية، والتأكد من مطابقتها للمواصفات الفنية. متابعة تنفيذ أعمال التمديدات الكهربائية، بما في ذلك تشغيل الدارات الكهربائية وإجراء الفحوصات اللازمة مثل فحوص العازلية والاستمرارية والتأريض. تشخيص أعطال التمديدات الكهربائية وتحديد الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة لمعالجتها، بالإضافة إلى متابعة أعمال الصيانة الوقائية. تطبيق جميع إجراءات وتعليمات السلامة والصحة المهنية لضمان بيئة عمل آمنة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال التمديدات الكهربائية. القدرة على قراءة وفهم المخططات الكهربائية. معرفة جيدة بأنواع المواد والأجهزة الكهربائية ومواصفاتها. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تشخيص الأعطال الكهربائية وتحديد الحلول المناسبة. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة المهنية في جميع مراحل العمل. الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في تنفيذ المهام. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق تكوين للصناعات المعدنية. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

c3f11835a4ec61b4.description: About the Role Wipro is seeking a Commercial Strategy & Loyalty Model Lead to join their team in Riyadh, Riyadh Province. c36c124efd6fddf3.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة مصنع جدة للدهانات والمعاجين عن مشغل آلة تعبئة منتجات كيميائية للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تشغيل ومراقبة آلات تعبئة المنتجات الكيميائية، مع ضمان الالتزام بإجراءات السلامة ومعايير التشغيل. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تشغيل آلات تعبئة المنتجات الكيميائية ومراقبتها بشكل مستمر. تغذية الآلات بالمواد الخام والعبوات اللازمة لعملية التعبئة. تفقد آلات تعبئة المنتجات الكيميائية وتعقيمها وفقاً للتعليمات المحددة. تسجيل كميات المواد المنتجة وأصنافها، بالإضافة إلى كميات مواد التغليف المستهلكة. خدمة موقع العمل وتطبيق جميع إجراءات وتعليمات السلامة والصحة المهنية والبيئة. المهام التشغيلية يتولى شاغل الوظيفة مسؤولية ضمان سير عمليات التعبئة بكفاءة ودقة، بما في ذلك تغذية الآلات بالمنتج المطلوب تعبئته وتزويدها بالعبوات والمواد المناسبة لكل منتج، مع الالتزام التام بالتعليمات التشغيلية المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تشغيل ومراقبة آلات التعبئة. الالتزام بتطبيق إجراءات وتعليمات السلامة في بيئة العمل. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة، ضمن بيئة عمل تتطلب الدقة والالتزام بمعايير الجودة والسلامة في التعامل مع المنتجات الكيميائية. تقديم الطلبات للراغبين في التقدم لهذه الوظيفة، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم عبر القنوات المتاحة.

c3ade54f12c9fb25.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث فرع شركة سوسيداد ايبيريكا دي كونستركشنز الكتريكاس عن فني ميكانيكي مركبات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على متابعة تركيب المركبات الميكانيكية، وتحديد القطع التبديلية، بالإضافة إلى فحص وتشخيص أعطال المركبات ومتابعة إصلاحها. المسؤوليات الرئيسية متابعة تركيب المركبات الميكانيكية وضمان سير إجراءات تشغيلها بكفاءة. تحديد القطع التبديلية اللازمة، ومطابقة مواصفاتها الفنية، والعمل على تأمينها. تنفيذ إجراءات استلام المركبات الميكانيكية المخصصة للخدمة والإصلاح. فحص وتشخيص أعطال المركبات بدقة ومتابعة عمليات إصلاحها. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعتمدة في جميع المهام. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال ميكانيكا المركبات أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على فهم ومتابعة إجراءات التركيب والتشغيل للمركبات الميكانيكية. معرفة جيدة بأنواع القطع التبديلية ومواصفاتها. مهارات في فحص وتشخيص الأعطال الميكانيكية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. سيعمل الفني ضمن فريق متخصص يركز على صيانة المركبات الميكانيكية وتشغيلها. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريقنا، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم عبر القنوات المتاحة.

c3b51a063f8410d5.description: About the Role Larsen & Toubro is seeking a QAQC Engineer Civil to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position suitable for candidates with 0-1 years of experience. The role focuses on ensuring the effective implementation of Project Quality Plans (PQP) and maintaining compliance with customer requirements throughout project sites. Key Responsibilities Ensure effective implementation of the Project Quality Plan (PQP) at project sites and compliance with customer requirements. Plan and conduct various inspections at different project stages, obtain necessary approvals, and work to minimize reworks and time loss while improving efficiency. Study and implement approved PQPs, Inspection and Test Plans (ITP), checklists, drawings, method statements, material/equipment approvals, technical specifications, and standards relevant to the project. Conduct internal inspections prior to consultant/client inspections to ensure correctness according to project requirements. Perform material and equipment inspections upon receipt at sites to ensure compliance with Purchase Order (PO), approval, and specification requirements, and verify proper storage. Raise Material Inspection Requests (MIR) as required and obtain approval/clearance from the customer representative. Raise Requests for Inspections (RFI/IR) as needed and obtain approval/clearance from the customer representative for various works/activities at different stages on site, preparing corresponding inspection records. Supervise site activities to ensure the use of approved drawings, materials, work methods, and correct sequences. Arrange and maintain all records in a traceable manner, including backups of soft forms. Coordinate with external laboratories for tests, reports, and related activities. Issue Non-Conformance Reports (NCR) or memos to Site Engineers and sub-contractors regarding deviations, specifying required corrective actions. Ensure timely implementation of proper corrective actions to close NCRs and initiate preventive measures as necessary. Verify that equipment and materials are properly stored and protected in accordance with contract specifications. Report all inspection and test results, along with any deviations, to the QAQC head in a timely manner. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 years of experience in a relevant field. Strong understanding of Project Quality Plans (PQP), Inspection and Test Plans (ITP), and quality control procedures. Ability to interpret technical specifications, drawings, and method statements. Work Environment This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and involves working on project sites to ensure quality assurance and control standards are met.

c3e84bad11fb038a.description: About the Role Imagination is seeking a Senior Production Lead to join our team in Riyadh. This full-time role involves the day-to-day management of team members within the wider Production team, focusing on resource planning, freelance staff booking, and ensuring project consistency and delivery. The Senior Production Lead will also undertake a hands-on production role for larger and more complex projects, operating in a client-facing capacity to present budgets and support business development. Key Responsibilities Ensure projects are delivered on budget and on time, adhering to high standards. Manage workflow and resourcing for projects within the role's remit, collaborating with Directors and resourcing personnel. Ensure the production team complies with Imagination standards, including profitable business practices, health and safety, commercial viability, documentation, and supplier best practices. Drive continuous process and delivery improvements across all delivery teams. Motivate, guide, and support the production team, contributing to their professional development. Develop practical working solutions for creative proposals, translating concepts into reality. Budget projects and programs, ensuring best value pricing, negotiating with suppliers, and selecting contractors. Oversee financial control of third-party spend and ensure Production Managers deliver projects within agreed timelines and budgets. Create and manage large-scale, complex budgets independently. Negotiate favorable costs and terms with suppliers and freelancers to deliver value. Collaborate with Project Directors/Managers for timely and precise financial reconciliation of production budgets upon project completion. Specify technical equipment and manufacturing in conjunction with Imagination specialist teams. Collaborate with the creative production team to develop solutions for live event scenarios across all streams. Schedule all trades throughout pre-production and delivery phases. Produce overall project time plans with Project Management & Creative, ensuring adherence to Imagination processes. Liaise with venues and conduct site visits as appropriate, reporting on suitability for required event modes. Develop and maintain supplier relationships, introducing new and innovative products and services. Manage Health and Safety on all projects in conjunction with the Imagination H&S Manager, including creating documentation to UK/global/regional standards. Fulfill the role in compliance with company policies and procedures, such as ISO documentation and Information Security training. Demonstrated ability to manage complex projects and budgets. Experience in client-facing roles, including presenting budgets and supporting business development. Hybrid work model, requiring a minimum of 3 days per week in the office. Comprehensive health insurance. Opportunities for increased public profile and exposure as a thought leader, including features in publications and participation as a panelist, speaker, or judge in select events. Monthly breakfasts and social sessions. Select educational support for growth and upskilling.

c3f7e0fd069799cc.description: About the Role DXC Technology is seeking an experienced Storage & Backup Engineer – Associate Manager to lead storage and backup operations. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and involves managing critical infrastructure within a large enterprise environment. Collaborate with infrastructure, application, database, and network teams to support business services. Maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, and recovery plans. Participate in CAB meetings, governance reviews, and service improvement initiatives. Manage incidents, requests, changes, and asset records through ServiceNow. Hands-on experience with Dell EMC Unity, PowerMax, Isilon, and Data Domain. Strong experience with Veritas NetBackup administration and troubleshooting. Knowledge of SAN, NAS, storage replication, and data protection technologies. Experience with Disaster Recovery planning and testing. Experience working in enterprise data center environments. Skills and Attributes Strong troubleshooting and stakeholder management skills. Ability to lead technical teams and drive operational excellence. c30470707aa2aff6.description: About Abdulaziz International School – Al-Sulaimaniah Abdulaziz International School – Al-Sulaimaniah (AIS–Al-Sulaimaniah), managed by SABIS®, is an English-medium, independent day school located in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. c370d51e680be6f2.description: About the Role Dar Al Riyadh is seeking a Senior Civil Structural Engineer to join their team in Yanbu. Knowledge of building codes and regulations related to steel structures. c371c1c2f535b3d4.description: About the Role Fakeeh Care Group is seeking an Office Manager to oversee administrative operations for an assigned Executive, Chief, or Departmental Head. c390caeb7dcf6686.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة اجال للمختبرات عن فني كيميائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة تنفيذ الأعمال الفنية والمخبرية المتعلقة باستقبال العينات وتجهيزها وتحليلها، بالإضافة إلى إجراء الاختبارات الكيميائية والمخبرية وفقًا للمعايير المعتمدة. يلتزم الفني الكيميائي بمتطلبات الجودة والسلامة المهنية وإجراءات التعامل الآمن مع العينات والمواد الكيميائية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية استقبال وتجهيز وتحضير العينات لإجراء الفحوصات والتحاليل. تنفيذ الاختبارات والتحاليل الكيميائية والمخبرية وفق الطرق والإجراءات المعتمدة. تشغيل الأجهزة والمعدات المخبرية والتأكد من جاهزيتها للاستخدام. تحضير المحاليل والكواشف والمواد اللازمة لإجراء الاختبارات. تسجيل وإدخال نتائج التحاليل في الأنظمة المعتمدة ومراجعة دقتها. تطبيق إجراءات ضبط ومراقبة الجودة على عمليات الفحص والتحليل. المحافظة على العينات وسلامة تخزينها والتعامل معها وفق الإجراءات المعتمدة. المحافظة على نظافة وترتيب المختبر والأجهزة والمعدات. الإبلاغ عن الأعطال والملاحظات الفنية المتعلقة بالأجهزة أو العينات. الالتزام بتعليمات السلامة والصحة المهنية عند التعامل مع المواد الكيميائية والعينات. توثيق الأعمال والنتائج وإعداد التقارير المخبرية حسب متطلبات العمل. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات المختبر والمعايير المعتمدة في الجودة والسلامة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تنفيذ الأعمال الفنية والمخبرية بدقة. معرفة جيدة بإجراءات ومعايير الاختبارات الكيميائية والمخبرية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تشغيل الأجهزة والمعدات المخبرية. القدرة على تسجيل وتوثيق نتائج التحاليل بدقة. الالتزام بمتطلبات الجودة والسلامة المهنية. مهارات التعامل الآمن مع العينات والمواد الكيميائية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ويقع في الرياض. سيعمل الفني الكيميائي ضمن فريق متخصص في مختبرات شركة اجال للمختبرات، مع التركيز على تطبيق أعلى معايير الجودة والسلامة. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في شركة اجال للمختبرات.

c3fda37b085ce5b0.description: About Daikin Saudi Daikin Saudi is a subsidiary of Daikin Middle East & Africa FZE, which is part of Daikin Industries Ltd. The company specializes in heating, cooling, ventilation, air purification, and refrigeration technology. Daikin designs, manufactures, and supplies a broad range of equipment and solutions for residential, commercial, and industrial applications across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa (EMEA). Daikin EMEA operates with over 12,000 employees across more than 59 consolidated subsidiaries and 12 major manufacturing facilities. Role Overview Daikin Saudi is seeking an HVAC Technician - Industrial Refrigeration for a full-time position in the Al Dar Al Baida District, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This role involves the installation, operation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of HVAC systems, with a focus on industrial refrigeration. The technician will work independently on-site, ensuring reliable system operation and high customer satisfaction while adhering to safety and service quality standards. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Perform installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair for Air-Cooled Chiller, Centrifugal Chiller, VRV & DX systems, Industrial Refrigeration (Ammonia Plant), and Commercial Refrigeration. Diagnose electrical, mechanical, and control faults, and implement corrective actions efficiently. Support commissioning, operation, and maintenance activities to ensure systems operate according to OEM standards. Identify root causes of system issues to minimize repeat breakdowns and optimize system performance through proper servicing, parameter checks, and minor adjustments. Escalate complex or recurring technical issues to supervisors as needed. Act as the on-site technical representative, maintaining professional communication with customers and explaining service activities, findings, and recommendations clearly. Complete service reports, checklists, and job documentation accurately and on time, recording system data, faults, and actions taken. Coordinate with supervisors, planners, and spare parts teams for smooth service execution. Adhere to all safety procedures, PPE requirements, and permit systems, ensuring safe handling of tools, equipment, and refrigerants. Stay updated on product knowledge, service practices, and new HVAC technologies, participating in trainings and applying learned skills in field activities. Qualifications and Experience Technical Diploma (ITI / Diploma in Mechanical, Refrigeration & Air Conditioning, or equivalent). Minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience in HVAC service, specifically in installation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of industrial refrigeration systems. Strong troubleshooting skills in electrical and refrigeration systems. Basic knowledge of HVAC controls and schematics reading. Ability to work independently at customer sites. Good communication and customer-handling skills. Familiarity with service reporting tools (manual or digital). Strong commitment to safety and quality standards. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, requiring on-site service execution and coordination with supervisors and service teams to meet contractual SLAs and operational targets.

c3244a2d68afd8e5.description: About Asteri Beauty Asteri Beauty is a high-performance beauty brand based in Saudi Arabia, specializing in clean, long-wearing formulas with rich color payoff and skin-loving ingredients. The company is expanding across the GCC and internationally, focusing on building a world-class beauty footprint. The Role of Wholesale Account Manager Asteri Beauty is seeking a Wholesale Account Manager to lead and execute commercial and strategic wholesale operations. This full-time role is based in Riyadh and focuses on key retail accounts across the GCC region, including major partners such as Ulta Beauty and Travel Retail (Duty Free / Airport Outlets). The position is central to growing brand visibility, driving revenue across physical and omnichannel wholesale doors, building key-partner relationships, and implementing trade marketing and inventory strategies. Key Responsibilities Formulate and execute Joint Business Plans (JBPs) for major retail partners, establishing sales targets, promotional calendars, and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). Drive sell-in and sell-through strategies across accounts, monitoring weekly and monthly sales data to identify growth opportunities. Lead negotiations for space and shelf-location, new product listings, end-cap placements, and travel-exclusive product offerings. Oversee the execution of in-store activations, promotional offers, Gift with Purchase (GWP) campaigns, and travel retail display activations. Serve as the main point of contact for retail buyers and category managers, managing range planning, assortment expansion, and promotional execution. Coordinate with internal teams including Marketing & Brand Communication, Supply Chain, Logistics & Operations, Finance & Commercial, and Retail Operations & Education/Training. Ensure smooth stock replenishment, logistics compliance, and adherence to retail distribution guidelines with retail partners. Internal and External Interactions The role requires close collaboration with various internal departments at Asteri Beauty, including Marketing & Brand Communication for campaign launches and retail activation plans, Supply Chain for demand forecasting and stock allocation, Finance for budget and margin analysis, and Retail Operations for brand standards and product education. Externally, the manager will build strategic relationships with retail buyers and category managers from key accounts like Ulta Beauty and Travel Retail, as well as with supply chain and merchandising teams of retail partners and duty-free distributors across the GCC region. Qualifications and Requirements 5-10 years of experience in a relevant field. Demonstrated ability to formulate and execute Joint Business Plans (JBPs). Experience in driving account performance and revenue growth. Proven negotiation skills and experience in assortment strategy. Background in trade marketing and promotions. c3ef54a4c00c6955.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة زهران للصيانه والتشغيل عن مهندس الصحة والسلامة والبيئة للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دراسة وتطوير معايير الصحة والسلامة والبيئة للمشاريع الهندسية، بالإضافة إلى مراقبة وتحليل عملية التنفيذ لضمان الامتثال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية المساهمة في عملية التصميم الشاملة وتقديم المشورة بشأن المواد ومعايير الجودة البيئية. الإشراف المباشر على أعمال صيانة المعدات وتصليحها بهدف تقليل العادم والمخلفات، والتأكد من سير العمليات وفقاً لمعايير الصحة والسلامة والبيئة. مراقبة العمليات وإجراء جولات تفقدية لمواقع التشغيل والعمليات، مع تقديم النصح والمشورة لضمان اتباع معايير سلامة البيئة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في مجال الصحة والسلامة والبيئة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشاريع الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب تقدمها، وعرضها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الصحة والسلامة والبيئة ضمن المشاريع الهندسية. فهم عميق لمعايير الصحة والسلامة والبيئة وتطبيقاتها. القدرة على تحليل العمليات وتقديم حلول لتحسين الأداء البيئي والسلامة. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات ممتازة في المراقبة والتفتيش. القدرة على تقديم المشورة والتوجيه الفني. مهارات إعداد التقارير والتوثيق. القدرة على مواكبة التطورات التقنية في المجال. بيئة العمل يعمل مهندس الصحة والسلامة والبيئة في بيئة ديناميكية تتطلب التواجد في مواقع التشغيل والمشاريع الهندسية في الرياض. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب الالتزام بمعايير الشركة وسياساتها. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف.

c31a29e56d11ccbc.description: About Four Seasons and The Red Sea Destination Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts focuses on delivering exceptional experiences for guests, residents, and partners globally. The company emphasizes a culture of mutual respect and continuous improvement. The Red Sea destination, located along 200 km of coastline between Umluj and Al Wajh in Saudi Arabia, is being developed as a luxury beachside destination with a focus on sustainable practices. The new Four Seasons Resort, situated on Shura Island, will feature approximately 149 rooms and suites, multiple dining outlets, meeting spaces, a marine discovery center, and extensive leisure facilities. Role Overview Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts is seeking a Director of Residences for the Four Seasons Hotel Red Sea, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role requires 5-10 years of experience and reports directly to the General Manager. The Director of Residences will lead the residential operation, ensuring that all residence owners, residents, and guests receive high levels of personalized service and operational excellence. This position is central to creating a seamless connection between the resort and residences while upholding Four Seasons standards. Key Responsibilities Lead and oversee all Residences operations, ensuring exceptional service delivery and adherence to Four Seasons standards. Build and maintain relationships with residence owners, residents, and stakeholders. Oversee residential services, including owner requests, arrivals/departures, housekeeping, maintenance, concierge, and lifestyle services. Collaborate with various resort departments (Rooms, Housekeeping, Engineering, Security, Finance, Food & Beverage, People & Culture) to ensure seamless support. Implement and monitor operating procedures, service standards, and quality controls for residential services. Ensure residence areas are maintained to high standards of cleanliness, safety, comfort, and presentation. Manage owner and resident feedback, concerns, and service recovery with professionalism. Support the preparation and management of residential budgets, service charges, forecasts, and operational expenses. Monitor performance indicators, service trends, owner satisfaction, and operational effectiveness. Ensure compliance with local regulations, property policies, brand standards, and management agreements. Lead, coach, train, and develop the Residences team, fostering a culture of accountability and service excellence. Support operational activities, residential readiness, handover processes, system implementation, and owner communication plans. Represent the residences professionally in meetings, inspections, owner interactions, and operational planning. Promote the Four Seasons Golden Rule by creating a trusted, respectful, and personalized residential experience. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Hospitality Management, Business Administration, Real Estate Management, or a related field is preferred. Proven experience (5-10 years) as a Director of Residences, Residences Manager, Director of Rooms, or senior operations leader within a luxury hotel, branded residences, or high-end residential environment. Strong understanding of luxury residential operations, owner relations, property management, and personalized service standards. Excellent leadership and people management skills, with the ability to build, coach, and develop a high-performing team. Strong financial acumen, including experience with budgets, service charges, cost control, and operational planning. High level of discretion, professionalism, integrity, and emotional intelligence when dealing with owners and residents. Strong communication, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills. Ability to work closely with resort operations while maintaining the privacy and expectations of residence owners and residents. Work Environment and Eligibility This full-time position is based at the Four Seasons Hotel Red Sea on Shura Island, located between Umluj and Al Wajh in Saudi Arabia. The role involves working within a luxury resort and residential environment, collaborating with various departments to ensure a cohesive and high-quality experience for all residents and guests. Suitable candidates must be eligible to work in Saudi Arabia.

c31d4aa4df2750b3.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة سراكو عن فني تدفئة وتهوية وتكييف للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة حفر الباطن. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تركيب وصيانة وإصلاح أنظمة التدفئة والتهوية وتكييف الهواء، بما في ذلك وحدات التدفئة والمضخات ومكيفات الهواء. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية المساهمة في عملية تصميم نظم التهوية وتكييف الهواء والتدفئة بشكل عام، وتقديم المشورة بشأن المواد ومعايير الجودة. تقديم الدعم للمشروعات الهندسية، والإشراف على تنفيذ العمليات وتركيب النظم، ووضع الجداول الزمنية وتقديرات التكلفة. تقديم الدعم في أعمال الصيانة وتصليح النظم. مراقبة الجوانب الفنية المتصلة بإنتاج وتركيب واستعمال وصيانة منظومات وأجهزة ومعدات التدفئة والتهوية والتكييف لضمان دقة الأداء ومطابقة المواصفات. اتباع سياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة يتطلب هذا الدور خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال تركيب وصيانة وإصلاح معدات التدفئة والتهوية وتكييف الهواء. يجب أن يكون المرشح قادراً على التعامل مع مجموعة متنوعة من الأنظمة والمعدات. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في حفر الباطن، المنطقة الشرقية. سيعمل الفني ضمن فريق متخصص لضمان كفاءة وسلامة أنظمة التدفئة والتهوية وتكييف الهواء. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، ولن يتم الكشف عنه في هذه المرحلة. نرحب بالمرشحين الذين يمتلكون المهارات والخبرة اللازمة للتقدم لهذه الفرصة.

c34543733d0546b2.description: About the Role Panda Retail Company – Savola Group is seeking a Category Manager to join their team in Makkah, with operations spanning Jeddah and Makkah. c3f0282402aa6134.description: The Fire Safety Engineer is responsible for delivering technical fire and life safety engineering activities across KAUST under the direction of the Fire Safety Engineering Lead. c341bf0edb76475b.description: The UI/UX Specialist is responsible for shaping, designing, and continuously improving user experiences across KAUST’s IT services and touch points. The role ensures that all interfaces and journeys adopt industry-leading user-centric design principles, accessibility standards, and align with the IT Department’s UI/UX framework. A key responsibility of this role is to establish, document, and communicate clear UI/UX processes and standards to stakeholders, ensuring consistent adoption across teams and projects. The specialist partners with service owners and user engagement specialists to conduct user research, develop prototypes, perform usability testing, and provide design governance. Through this work, the UI/UX Specialist enables the delivery of intuitive, efficient, and accessible digital experiences that support KAUST’s goals of operational excellence, technology enablement, and customer satisfaction. Responsibilities: Work with team members to define and maintain UI/UX principles, guidelines, and best practices for IT services. Review interfaces and service designs for alignment with established UX guidelines and provide feedback for improvement. Define and maintain UI/UX principles, guidelines, and best practices for IT services. Conduct user research (interviews, surveys, observations) to identify needs and pain points. Translate research insights into personas, journey maps, task flows, and actionable recommendations. Design intuitive, accessible interfaces, wireframes, prototypes, and interaction flows. Conduct usability testing and validate solutions through iterative feedback cycles. Collaborate with IT service owners, developers, and business analysts to ensure user-centered design. Ensure all designs comply with accessibility standards (e.g., WCAG 2.2), branding guidelines, and design systems. Provide feedback on interfaces, service designs, and design assets to maintain quality and consistency. Advocate for users, ensuring inclusivity, fairness, and accessibility in all design decisions. Facilitate workshops, co-design sessions, and collaborative design discussions with stakeholders. Bachelor’s degree in HCI, Information Systems, Graphic Design, or related field. 5+ years of experience in UI/UX design, user research, or usability evaluation. Strong knowledge of human-centered design principles, usability heuristics, and accessibility standards. Proficiency with modern design/prototyping tools such as Figma, Adobe XD, or equivalent. Solid understanding of responsive design, interaction design, design systems, and user research methods. Demonstrated experience leading end-to-end UX activities in complex, multi-stakeholder environments. Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder engagement skills. Attention to detail with a focus on producing high-quality, consistent, and accessible designs. Preferred: Experience in higher education or IT service environments, contributing to design systems or institutional branding. Preferred Certifications: NN/g UX Certification, IDEO U Design Thinking, CUA, CXA, or similar credentials.

c3043745f5d0628f.description: Müller's Solutions is actively seeking a SEC Facility Monitoring Engineer, exclusively for Saudi Nationals, to join our dynamic team. In this role. The SEC Facility Monitoring Engineer is a 24/7 role responsible for the real-time monitoring of all SEC corporate facilities (HQ, regional offices) to ensure a safe, secure, and operational environment. This role acts as the central command point, monitoring physical security, access control, and building management systems to immediately detect, assess, and respond to all security and safety incidents. Key Responsibilities: Monitor facility operations using advanced monitoring tools to ensure high availability and performance. Conduct regular inspections and assessments of facilities to identify and troubleshoot issues. Implement and manage facility monitoring systems, including alarms and alerts, to ensure prompt response to incidents. Collaborate with maintenance teams to address any facility-related issues and perform preventive maintenance. Generate and analyze reports on facility performance, uptime, and incident response. Maintain documentation of monitoring processes, incidents, and resolutions for compliance and operational improvement. Stay up-to-date with technologies and best practices related to facility monitoring and management. Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field. Minimum of 3 years of experience in facility monitoring or a related field. Strong knowledge of facility management systems and monitoring tools. Experience with data center operations and infrastructure monitoring is preferred. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills. Strong communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams. Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks effectively. Proficiency in English; knowledge of Arabic is a plus. Why Join Us: Opportunity to work with a talented and passionate team. Competitive salary and benefits package. Exciting projects and innovative work environment.
